question_evidence_quote: After she adds up all of her spending for the month she wants to set aside 10% of it to put into savings.
observed_error: The monthly spending total excludes the previously calculated $400 food budget.
violated_condition: Savings must equal 10% of all monthly spending, including four weeks of food.
error_description: The response labels rent, streaming, and cell phone costs totaling $1580 as all monthly spending, omitting the $400 food budget it already calculated for four weeks. The addition is correct, but the savings base must include food as well as the other monthly expenses.
